purpose: Internal visual research for a fictional large map with distributed Chongqing-inspired architecture and culture. These photographs are references, not commissioned game art.
rights_summary: Seven Wikimedia Commons photographs have explicit CC licenses recorded below. Two Qiyiwang photographs are reference-only because game and commercial reuse permission was not verified. Copyright licenses do not automatically clear identifiable-person, trademark, privacy, publicity, or other non-copyright rights.

cultural_sources.title: 龙舞（铜梁龙舞）
cultural_sources.source_type: 中国非物质文化遗产数字博物馆项目条目
cultural_sources.research_note: The entry identifies the project with Chongqing and describes 龙灯舞 and 彩灯舞 series. No locally verified, clearly licensed Tongliang performance photo was found for this collection, so a generic dragon-dance photograph was deliberately not substituted.

cultural_sources.title: 川江号子
cultural_sources.region: 重庆及川东长江航运文化带
cultural_sources.source_type: 中国非物质文化遗产数字博物馆项目条目
cultural_sources.research_note: Use as river-workers' work-song culture with lead-and-response singing; do not present it as a custom unique to one Chongqing neighborhood or as a universal city ritual.

cultural_sources.title: 夏布织造技艺
cultural_sources.region: 重庆市荣昌区，主要分布于盘龙镇
cultural_sources.source_type: 中国非物质文化遗产数字博物馆，荣昌传统工艺工作站报道
cultural_sources.research_note: The official craft-station report identifies Rongchang Xia Bu and ramie fibre weaving. The additional project overview describes the craft sequence and Panlong distribution. Treat it as a Rongchang craft tradition rather than a generic Chongqing textile custom.

cultural_sources.title: 黄桷坪交通茶馆生活场景
cultural_sources.region: 重庆市九龙坡区黄桷坪
cultural_sources.research_note: The report locates Traffic Teahouse in Huangjueping and describes its indoor old-building setting. The included Commons photograph is not evidence of outdoor 坝坝茶; research that practice separately before assigning it to a fictional district.

assets.subject: 山城巷坡坎与街巷
assets.author: HoweyYuan (Wikimedia Commons attribution; user page unavailable)
assets.rights_note: Attribute the author, link the license, note changes; adaptations must follow ShareAlike terms. This image shows a contemporary visitor area and should not be treated as an untouched historical streetscape.
borrowable_details: Stairs and sloped paths follow the terrain.
Small buildings, walls, and landings make layered sightlines.
Use the spatial rhythm, not the real route or shop signs.

assets.subject: 洪崖洞夜间层叠建筑
assets.author: Lianguanlun
assets.rights_note: Attribute the author, link the license, and note changes. The photo documents a contemporary commercial landmark, not a preserved ancient settlement.
borrowable_details: Repeated eaves and stacked platforms create a strong night silhouette.
Warm windows against a darker river/city mass can guide landmark lighting.
Reserve this high-density tourist aesthetic for a few landmarks rather than the whole map.

assets.subject: 長江索道與江岸交通
assets.author: rheins
assets.rights_note: Attribute the author, link the license, and note changes. Photo taken 2015-04-10; do not use it as a current-state survey.
borrowable_details: A cableway can act as a cross-district travel line and distant map anchor.
Study the cable direction, river crossing, and height difference between banks.

assets.subject: 東水門長江大橋與城市尺度
assets.author: JamesYoung8167
assets.rights_note: Attribute the author, link the license, note changes; adaptations must follow ShareAlike terms.
borrowable_details: Cable-stayed towers, piers, and the surrounding skyline establish distance and scale.
Study the open riverside spaces beneath and beside the bridge.

assets.subject: 黃桷坪交通茶館生活場景
assets.author: Liming Huang
assets.rights_note: Commons metadata flags personality restrictions. Use only to observe the room and daily-life composition; do not reproduce identifiable people or assume publicity/model releases. Adaptations must follow ShareAlike terms.
borrowable_details: Table spacing, thermos flasks, worn timber, and daylight describe ordinary indoor social life.
This is an indoor teahouse photo, not evidence for outdoor 坝坝茶.
Avoid copying the photographed patrons into game art.

assets.subject: 磁器口街巷建筑
assets.author: Willi Weasel
assets.rights_note: Attribute the author, link the license, note changes; adaptations must follow ShareAlike terms. Treat this as a visitor-district streetscape, not a universal Chongqing residential street.
borrowable_details: Study how narrow shopfronts, signs, eaves, and walking paths pace the street.
Use the variation in door and facade width, not the photographed business identities.

assets.subject: 十八梯古井廣場街區層次
assets.author: Daredemodaisuki 114514
assets.rights_note: Attribute the author, link the license, note changes; adaptations must follow ShareAlike terms. This is a contemporary visitor-area view, not a reconstruction source for the old neighborhood.
borrowable_details: A sloped public landing can connect footpaths at different heights.
New and old-looking facades can sit in the same sightline; distinguish current rebuilt scenery from preserved historic fabric.

assets.subject: 山城巷台阶街巷与多层房屋
assets.author: 王欢 (page caption)
assets.rights_note: The source page says转载时注明七一网并欢迎转载, but that does not establish permission for commercial game use, adaptation, or redistribution. Keep this file as internal visual research only.
borrowable_details: The stair lane runs between masonry lower floors and tiled-roof upper floors.
Study the path, retaining walls, vegetation, and doors at several heights; this image is a street view, not an open-river cliff view.

assets.subject: 戴家巷崖線街巷與建築
assets.author: Not identified in the supplied caption/image metadata
assets.rights_note: The source page says转载时注明七一网并欢迎转载, but that does not establish permission for commercial game use, adaptation, or redistribution. Keep this file as internal visual research only.
borrowable_details: Timber roofs and platforms stack down a planted cliff toward the river.
